CH2_HEADING

Chapter two body text with its own footnote marker[1] in it.

Chapter two also has a same-file jumpCH2_SAMEFILE_LINK with a duplicated name.

CH2_LOCAL_TARGET

A whole-file linkCH2_TO_CH1_WHOLE with no fragment.

A link to another document's body idCH2_TO_CH1_BODY means that document.

A bare hashCH2_BARE_HASH means the top of this one.

An empty hrefCH2_EMPTY_HREF names nothing and must be left alone.
